title: Mediterranean Chicken Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish that blends the sweetness of pilaf with the savory taste of chicken and Mediterranean spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the pilaf rice to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add the Mediterranean seasoning, parsley, and lemon juice to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the pilaf mixture to a serving dish and serve hot.
Garnish with additional parsley, if desired.
